orchestrator_policy.gate_reason: solar_kpno_kurucz2005_corrected: kpno_solar_atlas is registered telluric_required=no on basis 'line_selection', so tellurics are handled by per-line clean-line selection over 9 enumerated bands (RYA-460/786), not by a correction stage. telluric_applied=applied. No telluric_corrected declaration is made.

band.name: red-optical
band.continuum_treatment: atlas continuum trusted where the source is pre-normalised
band.justification: The cleanest regime we have: 1.87 A median gap and a continuum within 0.3% of unity. That is exactly why it is dangerous — a broken method looks HEALTHIER here than in the blue while being wrong in the same way, and there is no reference value to catch it. Telluric masking is mandatory: the O2 A-band (7600-7640) and H2O (9280-9600) are terrestrial, not solar.
band.systematic_floor_note: Sparse crowding means uncatalogued neighbours are rarer but not absent — 98 of 174 Fe I failures here were windows dominated by a real solar line missing from our list. Line-list completeness is the dominant systematic, not blending.

orchestrator_policy.action: Serve corrected pre-normalized product unchanged; no second correction or continuum placement

interpretation: No observational continuum or parameter optimizer; all responses reported, not ranked as a best star model
True Teff changes use independent MARCS structures; xi changes line/SE microturbulence at fixed t01 atmosphere
5500/6000 K controls use common one-layer bottom cut, with separate 5750 K depth controls
R interval is catalog capability, not a measured local FTS sinc LSF; iSpec Gaussian resolution is an approximation
Solar broadening/rotation use canonical inputs; +/-1 km/s and RV +/-0.5 are diagnostic probes, not inferred uncertainties
Published Kitt Peak continuum and corrected telluric product remain frozen; no local pixel telluric covariance is manufactured
